profile_text.body:
X Corp is a for-profit company founded in 2023 and headquartered in Bastrop, Texas. Its website at x.com presents the service as a place to follow breaking news, entertainment, sports and politics with live commentary, and it offers email or username sign-in, with links to its terms of service, privacy policy and cookie use. The site's navigation points to an app download, help, careers, advertising and business, developer, news and accessibility pages, and it carries a 2026 X Corp copyright notice.

The site lists Grok among its linked destinations, but no specific AI products are tracked for the company in the available record. No MCP servers are recorded either.

On litigation, no individual cases are listed. The recorded legal exposure is in Texas, where 103 matters are counted.
